### Saved by Sacrifice
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/saved-by-sacrifice.html
Passage: Exodus 12:13
Points:
- The Israelites were not naturally immune to judgment, as sin brought death to all.
- God provided deliverance by establishing the principle of substitutionary sacrifice.
- Painting the lamb's blood on the doorframe guaranteed that judgment passed over the home.
- The Passover foreshadowed Jesus Christ, the true Lamb who takes away sin.
- Christians taking Communion look back to Christ bearing their punishment on the cross.

### The Lamb of God
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-daily-devotion-dec-2-2008-11596278.html
Passage: Exodus 12:13
Points:
- The Passover reveals a personal progression in viewing Christ: a lamb, the lamb, and your lamb.
- Many people initially view Jesus only from a distance as a notable teacher.
- Spiritual understanding grows when one recognizes Jesus as the unique Lamb of God.
- True salvation occurs only when an individual embraces Jesus personally as Savior and Lord.
- Knowing that Christ died is not enough until you receive Him for your own sins.

### The Real Battle Foreshadowed
Author: Michael Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-may-19-2025.html
Passage: Exodus 12:1-13
Points:
- The final plague of the firstborn brought judgment across Egypt to break Pharaoh's resistance.
- Israelite homes were spared because they followed God's command to sacrifice a spotless lamb.
- Marking doorframes with blood signaled divine protection so death would pass over them.
- The Passover lamb foreshadows Jesus, the sinless Son of God offered for humanity.
- Believers escape condemnation because they are covered by the blood of Christ.

### Unlocking the Bible: Redemption (Exodus 12:1-13)
Author: Colin Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/unlocking-the-bible-redemption-exodus-121-13/
Passage: Exodus 12:1-13
Points:
- Sacrificial blood marked on the doorframes signified that death had already taken place.
- Christ absorbed the curse of sin by suffering the death believers rightfully deserved.
- Believers united with Jesus can rest knowing their judgment has already been paid.
- God delivers His people from judgment so they are freed to worship and walk with Him.
- Because Christians still sin, ongoing fellowship with God is sustained entirely through Christ's sacrifice.
